about: Companies in the accuracy check: one data-only golden case each, its SEC CIK and statement currency, filings read from their own XBRL instance (ones SEC companyfacts lacks, and ones whose line is a filer extension element, read as ext:Name), ADS scaling, and per-figure recipe overrides (each with the reason) where the issuer's statements use another concept than the default in scripts/accuracy/recipes.ts. An override names the shared building blocks ({"op": "use"}, {"op": "currentDebt"}) instead of restating them. An override states what was checked in one filing; check it again when the reference is rebuilt for a later period.

terms.role: borrowings (current, related-party current and noncurrent debt)

totalDebtIncludingLeases.latest.why: FIGR tags its total borrowings as LongTermDebt: in the 10-Q for 2026-06-30 (0001628280-26-057061) LongTermDebt 962,995k is the noncurrent line (LongTermDebtNoncurrent 315,850k) plus the two current debt lines, which carry a related-party member and so are not in companyfacts (current liabilities 1,285,124k less payables 58,215k, servicing liability 506,686k and other 73,078k = 647,145k)

totalDebtIncludingLeases.latest.why: MU tags total debt including finance-lease obligations as DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations: in the 10-K for 2026-09-03 (0000723125-26-000023) 5,179M is current debt 491M (DebtCurrent, all of it the current finance lease liability) plus LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations 4,688M, which is long-term debt 2,792M plus noncurrent finance leases 1,896M

fv.netDebt.why: MU tags total debt including finance-lease obligations as DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations (see totalDebtIncludingLeases.latest)

cashAndShortTermInvestments.latest.why: NVDA presents two current marketable-securities lines, debt and equity: in the 10-Q for 2026-07-26 (0001045810-26-000075) AssetsCurrent 197,412M is cash 22,443M + marketable debt securities 34,143M (DebtSecuritiesCurrent) + marketable equity securities 42,783M (EquitySecuritiesFvNi) + receivables 63,059M + inventories 31,575M + prepaid and other 3,409M

fv.netDebt.why: the report's bridge adds NVDA's marketable equity securities (EquitySecuritiesFvNi, a current-asset line) as a non-operating asset of their own, so its net debt deducts cash and marketable debt securities only; both are filed current-asset lines (in the 10-Q for 2026-07-26 (0001045810-26-000075) AssetsCurrent 197,412M is cash 22,443M + marketable debt securities 34,143M (DebtSecuritiesCurrent) + marketable equity securities 42,783M (EquitySecuritiesFvNi) + receivables 63,059M + inventories 31,575M + prepaid and other 3,409M)

fv.nonOperatingInvestments.why: NVDA's only long-term investment line is the balance-sheet line Non-marketable securities, tagged with its own element: in the 10-Q for 2026-07-26 (0001045810-26-000075) Assets 320,272M is current assets 197,412M + property 14,285M + operating lease assets 5,390M + goodwill 21,125M + intangibles 2,998M + deferred tax 12,159M + non-marketable securities 51,157M + other 15,746M; the note amount EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDeterminableFairValueAmount 47,898M is part of that line
